facts: The case arises out of the same incident for which all accused persons have been convicted and sentenced.

On December 24th, 1989, at about 1:30 P.M., FIR was lodged by informant-PW6, Birender Pandey informing that he along with Bharat Pandey (PW5) and Kanhaiya Pandey (deceased) were standing in their field.
Appellant-Raghunath Pandey after getting his buffalo washed in the canal reached near Birender Pandey's field and drove the buffalo to graze the tori crop grown in the field.
Birender Pandey objected to it, whereupon Raghunath Pandey abused him which was resisted by Kanhaiya Pandey (deceased).
On this Raghunath Pandey went to his residence and returned with other accused persons, armed.
Raghunath Pandey was armed with rifle and other accused persons, Parshuram Pandey and Bishram Pandey were armed with gun and Somaru Pandey armed with spear.
issues: Whether the prosecution's case inspires confidence in the circumstances of the case.
Whether the defence plea of accidental firing deserves rejection.
petitioner_arguments: The fact situation alleged by the prosecution does not inspire confidence in the circumstances of the case.
It was impossible for the accused Raghunath Pandey to put his buffalo in the field for grazing when Birender Pandey, Bharat Pandey and Kanhaiya Pandey were standing in the field.
The whole genesis of the incident is false and therefore the prosecution could not be believed.
respondent_arguments: The incident might have commenced somewhat in different manner but the fact of the commission of the offence, when proved by the witnesses the prosecution's case cannot be thrown out only on the basis that prosecution has put inflated version of the commencement of incident.
PW6 - Birender Pandey, the informant reiterated his version as given in the FIR.
court_reasoning: The deposition of these witnesses read with the statement of PW5 Bharat Pandey and the incident recorded in the FIR leaves no manner of doubt that these witnesses were not the eye-witnesses and have not seen the incident happening.
They reached the spot later on.
holding: Leave granted in S.L.P. (Crl.) No.2238 of 2004.
